name: Exterior Deck Stain Coat 1
intent: Stain application by item type: floor (SF), railing (LF), spindles (EA), stairs (EA).
doctrine: Deck stain coat 1. Floor 200 SF/hr (brush/pad/roller). Railing 12 LF/hr (brush all faces). Spindles 10 EA/hr (~6 min each, brush all faces). Stairs 3 EA/hr (~20 min each including tread, riser, stringer). No spray on horizontal deck surfaces.
